text: CARC 101 Cultural and Social Issues in the Natural, Built and Virtual Environment Credits: 3. 3 Lecture Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. Introduction to cultural and social issues in planning, design, construction, creativity and the visual arts; exploration of how individual and collective values and beliefs are expressed in the practice of architecture, landscape architecture, urban planning, construction science and the arts; how these fields internalize and reify these values while creating the natural, built and virtual environments; emphasis on civil discourse to help recognize positionality and work collaboratively in a multicultural society.

text: CARC 411 Interdisciplinary Methods on Smart and Connected Communities Credits: 3. 3 Lecture Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours.
